title: CITATION.cff validation experiment: minimal-valid vs. field-dropped contrast pair
purpose: A bounded experiment brief with two contrasting CITATION.cff files. File A is minimal-but-valid per the CFF schema (all required fields present). File B deliberately omits the required cff-version field. The discriminating test: run cffconvert --validate on each and compare output. This lets a practitioner observe exactly which error cffconvert emits for a missing required field vs. a clean pass — turning the README's undocumented validation step into an observable result.
